mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings slowdowns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 5.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) signals contraction in household demand, reducing corporate sales and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 signals supply chain constraints and reduced manufacturing output, preceding economic slowdowns that cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals strong aggregate demand that boosts corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% over a 3-month period signals monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs, reducing corporate investment and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 5.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the central bank's policy shift increases risk-free rates, discounting future cash flows more heavily and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
